questions.translation: Si recuerdan una sola cosa de esta sección, debería ser que el acceso del atacante duró solo doce minutos.

questions.question: After showing separate identity and endpoint timelines, the next slide combines them. Which preview explains its value?
options: The next slide puts those events into a single end-to-end view.
The next slide combines the separate timelines so that we can compare the events more easily.
Next, we'll look at a consolidated timeline covering the incident from beginning to end.
The following view aligns all events from the two data sources in chronological order.
questions.explanation: Puts those events into a single... view explica qué aporta la siguiente diapositiva. End-to-end es habitual en contexto profesional. Puts those events into a single end-to-end view explica integración y alcance; las otras enfatizan comparación, beginning to end o alineación técnica.
questions.translation: La siguiente diapositiva reúne esos eventos en una única vista de principio a fin.

questions.question: Analysts may want the full SIEM query, but it would distract from the customer briefing. Which sentence preserves access to the detail?
options: The query syntax is too detailed for this meeting, so I've moved it to the appendix.
I won't go into the query syntax here, but the full search is included in the appendix.
I won't cover the search itself, but the appendix contains the technical implementation.
For anyone interested in the query, the complete syntax is available after the main presentation.
questions.explanation: Won't go into... here mantiene el foco. Included in the appendix indica dónde encontrar el detalle. La correcta mantiene el foco y da una ubicación concreta; las demás califican too detailed, cambian search por implementación o no nombran el apéndice.
questions.translation: No entraré aquí en la sintaxis de la consulta, pero la búsqueda completa está incluida en el apéndice.

questions.question: You have presented the incident and the response. Which transition tells the audience that recommendations are the final section?
options: The last part of the presentation covers the recommendations arising from the investigation.
Now that the incident and response are clear, we can consider what should happen next.
I'll close by presenting the actions we believe the organization should prioritize.
We've covered what happened and how we responded. Let me finish with the recommended next steps.
questions.explanation: We've covered... Let me finish with... resume lo anterior y señala claramente la sección final. We've covered... Let me finish... resume y orienta; las otras son más formales, condicionales o introducen priorización no mencionada.
questions.translation: Hemos cubierto qué ocurrió y cómo respondimos. Permítanme terminar con los próximos pasos recomendados.

questions.question: Leadership gives you one sentence to summarize a token-theft incident. Which version includes vector, impact boundary, and containment outcome?
options: A stolen token enabled unauthorized email access, although no privileged systems were affected.
The attacker used a user token to access email until containment prevented further movement.
A stolen user token was used to access email, but we contained the activity before the attacker reached any privileged systems.
Email was accessed with a stolen token, but the incident remained limited to the affected account.
questions.explanation: La frase reúne el vector, la acción observada y el límite de impacto. La voz activa we contained... before the attacker reached suena más natural al hablar. La correcta conserva vector, acceso, actor y punto de contención; las otras amplían a no affected, omiten el límite concreto o dicen que quedó en una cuenta.
questions.translation: Se utilizó un token de usuario robado para acceder al correo, pero contuvimos la actividad antes de que el atacante alcanzara ningún sistema privilegiado.

questions.question: A senior audience wants the result first. Which opening gives status, critical-service impact, and remaining work in that order?
options: We contained the incident without critical service disruption, and two follow-up items are being tracked.
The response was successful: no critical services were affected, although two actions remain.
The incident is now under control, with services operating normally and two actions still open.
The incident is contained, no critical service was disrupted, and two follow-up actions remain open.
questions.explanation: La frase abre con estado, impacto y pendientes: los tres datos que una audiencia ejecutiva necesita primero. La correcta usa tres hechos paralelos; las demás juzgan success, amplían disrupted a affected/normal o usan under control menos preciso.
questions.translation: El incidente está contenido, no se interrumpió ningún servicio crítico y quedan abiertas dos acciones de seguimiento.

questions.question: The root cause is a token-lifetime policy, not an individual error. Which executive explanation stays understandable and non-blaming?
options: The incident was caused by an identity setting that kept the stolen token active for too long.
The main control weakness was excessive token validity under the existing identity policy.
The underlying issue was an identity policy that allowed the stolen token to remain valid longer than intended.
The root cause was a policy gap that delayed invalidation of the compromised token.
questions.explanation: Underlying issue evita un juicio impreciso como bad. La consecuencia de la política se explica en lenguaje comprensible. Underlying issue y longer than intended describen el mecanismo sin too long, excessive o gap como juicio más duro.
questions.translation: El problema subyacente fue una política de identidad que permitió que el token robado siguiera siendo válido más tiempo del previsto.

questions.question: A director asks, “Are we safe now?” Two validation checks remain. Which answer is direct without offering a guarantee?
options: Yes. The incident is contained, although we still need to complete two routine checks.
The current evidence indicates that the immediate risk has been addressed, but validation is continuing.
The immediate activity has been contained. We are completing two checks before we close the incident.
We believe the environment is safe; two final checks remain before formal closure.
questions.explanation: La respuesta contesta primero y añade la condición pendiente. Evita tanto una garantía absoluta como una evasiva. La correcta responde con estado y condición concreta; las otras empiezan con yes, hablan de evidence/risk o usan safe como evaluación.
questions.translation: La actividad inmediata se ha contenido. Estamos completando dos comprobaciones antes de cerrar el incidente.

questions.question: A lessons-learned slide must address slow token revocation without assigning fault to the identity team. Select the best phrasing.
options: The incident showed that our token-revocation process needs to be faster and more consistent.
We learned that token revocation was not fast or consistent enough during the incident.
The response exposed delays and inconsistency in the way the identity team revokes tokens.
One improvement is to make token revocation faster and apply the process consistently across teams.
questions.explanation: The incident showed that... centra la mejora en el proceso. Needs to be faster and more consistent concreta el aprendizaje. The incident showed that our process... centra la mejora sistémica; las otras evalúan el desempeño, nombran al equipo o formulan una acción distinta.
questions.translation: El incidente mostró que nuestro proceso de revocación de tokens debe ser más rápido y coherente.

questions.question: You are recommending phishing-resistant authentication after a token-theft case. Which sentence links the control to the observed risk?
options: We recommend enforcing phishing-resistant authentication because it directly reduces the risk of this type of account compromise.
We recommend phishing-resistant authentication because it is the strongest available identity control.
Phishing-resistant authentication should be prioritized to improve the organization's overall security posture.
We recommend implementing stronger authentication to prevent a similar incident from happening again.
questions.explanation: La recomendación nombra la medida y la conecta con el riesgo observado. This type of account compromise es una combinación más natural y precisa. La correcta vincula control y riesgo concreto; las otras hacen afirmaciones generales, usan security posture o prometen prevent.
questions.translation: Recomendamos aplicar autenticación resistente al phishing porque reduce directamente el riesgo de este tipo de compromiso de cuenta.

questions.question: The proposed policy change is small but materially shortens token exposure. Which sentence gives leadership a proportional cost-benefit message?
options: The change is relatively easy to implement and would remove most of the current exposure.
A small implementation effort would produce a substantial improvement in token security.
The change requires limited effort and would significantly reduce the window of exposure.
The expected security benefit is high compared with the limited cost of the change.
questions.explanation: Limited effort y significantly reduce describen la relación sin prometer coste cero ni eliminación total del riesgo. Limited effort y significantly reduce son prudentes y concretos; las otras prometen easy/remove most o introducen cost y high benefit no cuantificados.
questions.translation: El cambio requiere un esfuerzo limitado y reduciría significativamente la ventana de exposición.

questions.question: Which closing takeaway acknowledges that detection succeeded while keeping prevention and revocation on the improvement agenda?
options: The key lesson is that detection was effective, although prevention and revocation did not perform as expected.
Detection worked in this case, but stronger preventive controls would have avoided the incident.
The key takeaway is that detection worked, but prevention and token revocation need to be strengthened further.
Our response detected the activity, while prevention and token revocation remain the main weaknesses.
questions.explanation: La frase reconoce un control eficaz y señala dos áreas de mejora. Need to be strengthened further suena más natural al hablar que el sustantivo further strengthening. La correcta es constructiva; las otras valoran performance, afirman que se habría evitado o etiquetan weaknesses.
questions.translation: La conclusión clave es que la detección funcionó, pero la prevención y la revocación de tokens deben reforzarse aún más.

questions.question: A senior stakeholder asks why low-volume events were not detected before the sign-in pattern changed. Which answer explains the mechanism rather than blaming the SOC?
options: The earlier events did not cross the alert threshold; detection occurred when the sign-in pattern changed.
The SOC did not receive an alert until the activity became sufficiently unusual to trigger the detection.
Earlier activity remained below the configured threshold, so the monitoring platform did not classify it as suspicious.
Detection was delayed because the first events looked similar to normal user behavior.
questions.explanation: La respuesta explica el mecanismo exacto sin culpar ni especular. Did not cross the threshold y when the pattern changed son datos comprensibles. La correcta describe umbral y cambio de patrón de manera neutral; las otras centran SOC/plataforma o hablan de delay y normalidad.
questions.translation: Los eventos anteriores no superaron el umbral de alerta; la detección se produjo cuando cambió el patrón de inicio de sesión.

questions.question: Your final status sentence must include completion, ownership, and expected closure. Which version gives all three cleanly?
options: Containment is complete, and the identity team expects to finish the remaining actions by Friday.
Containment is complete, the identity team owns the remaining actions, and we expect closure by Friday.
The identity team now owns the final actions, with incident closure planned for Friday.
We have completed containment and assigned the remaining actions to Identity before Friday's closure.
questions.explanation: La estructura paralela reúne tres mensajes ejecutivos: estado, responsable y previsión temporal. La correcta conserva tres elementos independientes; las otras mezclan responsable con previsión o convierten Friday en fecha comprometida.
questions.translation: La contención ha finalizado, el equipo de identidad es responsable de las acciones restantes y esperamos cerrar el incidente el viernes.

questions.topic: Presenting an incident · Closing and Q&A
questions.question: The formal briefing is finished and you are opening the Q&A. Which close sounds most natural aloud?
options: That covers the main findings and the actions taken. I'm happy to take your questions.
That concludes the findings and response section. I can now address any questions you may have.
We've reached the end of the presentation, so please raise any questions or concerns.
Those were the main findings and actions. Let me know what you would like me to clarify.
questions.explanation: That covers... es un cierre oral natural. The actions taken concreta que se resumen medidas ya realizadas, y take your questions es la expresión habitual. La correcta es cálida y directa; las otras suenan más formales, enfatizan el final o limitan las preguntas a aclaraciones.
questions.translation: Con esto hemos cubierto los principales hallazgos y las medidas adoptadas. Estaré encantada de responder a sus preguntas.

questions.topic: Presenting an incident · Closing and Q&A
questions.question: A customer asks a complex question about whether containment changed the evidence. You need a few seconds to structure the answer. What do you say?
options: That's a complex question, so I'll need a moment to consider the technical implications.
That's an important question. Let me take a moment to answer it clearly.
Let me make sure I understand the question before I give you a complete answer.
I want to be precise here; give me a moment to organize the evidence.
questions.explanation: Reconocer que la pregunta es important suena natural en una conversación profesional. Let me take a moment gana tiempo sin parecer evasivo. La correcta reconoce y gana tiempo sin calificar complejidad, fingir falta de comprensión ni pedir una pausa de forma brusca.
questions.translation: Es una pregunta importante. Déjenme un momento para responderla con claridad.

questions.topic: Presenting an incident · Closing and Q&A
questions.question: During Q&A, a director asks for a metric that is not in your notes. Which response protects accuracy and commits to a follow-up?
options: I don't have the exact figure in front of me, but I believe it is included in the written report.
I don't have that figure to hand, but I'll confirm it after the call.
I'll need to verify that number and send it to you with the meeting notes.
That figure is not on this slide; I can ask the reporting team to confirm it later.
questions.explanation: Don't have that figure to hand es natural. Confirm it after the call evita inventar una cifra y ofrece un siguiente paso. Don't have that figure to hand y I'll confirm it combinan honestidad y responsabilidad; las otras especulan sobre el informe, cambian el canal o delegan.
questions.translation: No tengo esa cifra a mano, pero la confirmaré después de la llamada.

questions.topic: Presenting an incident · Closing and Q&A
questions.question: A question about long-term architecture is relevant but outside the incident update. Which answer acknowledges it and protects the agenda?
options: That is related, but it sits outside today's scope. I'll capture it as a follow-up.
That is an important topic, but it would be better addressed in a separate architecture discussion.
The question is outside the scope of this incident, so I'll ask the architecture team to follow up.
We can return to that topic after the incident questions if there is enough time.
questions.explanation: That is related reconoce la relevancia. Sits outside today's scope y capture it as a follow-up mantienen el foco y garantizan seguimiento. La correcta reconoce relación, fija límite y captura seguimiento; las otras aplazan a otra reunión/equipo o dejan el seguimiento condicionado al tiempo.
questions.translation: Está relacionado, pero queda fuera del alcance de hoy. Lo recogeré como punto de seguimiento.

questions.topic: Presenting an incident · Closing and Q&A
questions.question: Before ending the call, you need to restate incident status, ongoing work, and the next communication. Which recap is complete but concise?
options: To summarize, containment is complete, validation continues, and we will provide another update tomorrow.
The incident is contained and remains under validation; the written report will follow tomorrow morning.
To recap: the incident is contained, validation is ongoing, and the next written update will be sent tomorrow morning.
In closing, the immediate risk is addressed, the checks are ongoing, and the next communication is scheduled for tomorrow.
questions.explanation: To recap introduce un resumen final. La frase confirma estado, actividad en curso y próximo hito con una estructura paralela. La correcta nombra los tres elementos y el momento exacto; las otras omiten written, cambian update por report o sustituyen estado por una evaluación de riesgo.
questions.translation: En resumen: el incidente está contenido, la validación sigue en curso y la próxima actualización escrita se enviará mañana por la mañana.
